blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corp. (Pagcor) is upping the ante against illegal online gambling, giving players a new way to tell which sites are playing a fair hand. In its latest bet on technology, Pagcor said it was developing a mobile app that could be in players’ hands as early as December.
